candidate.answerReason: A profit rate of at least \(20\%\) requires a selling price of at least \(80(1.2)=96\) yuan. Thus \(12x\geq96\), so the minimum is \(x=8\).

methods.label: Profit threshold
methods.explanation: The selling price is \(120\times x/10\). A profit rate of at least \(20\%\) means the selling price must be \(\geq80\times1.2=96\), so \(12x\geq96\), giving \(x\geq8\). Thus, the minimum selling price is 8 tenths of the marked price.
